summary: Completed a deep survey across graph DP, topology privacy, property/distribution privacy, private structure learning, attacks, and NRI. Corrected a material assumption: canonical NRI samples a fresh interaction graph per simulation, so the previous shared-topology formulation is a modified fixed-system setting. Split the research question into canonical per-instance/inference-time topology privacy and fixed-system/global-topology privacy; documented terminology collisions and the private-structure-learning vs structure-private-learning distinction.
termination_reason: The literature map and data-generating semantics changed the project formulation enough to justify a durable milestone. Next work should move from broad survey to protected-object matrix and implementation feasibility.
